_about: The language pack. You are the conductor, each agent thread is an instrument, and the commands are stage directions: words whose everyday meaning is the action, but which almost never occur in a software instruction. The first phrase in each list is the one the dispatcher itself says when it prompts you; the rest are aliases. Phrases are matched after lowercasing and stripping punctuation. Only a terminator ends a transmission. A command only counts when it is the whole utterance (a trailing courtesy word is allowed: 'bravo, over').
